## Projects

- **BinaryInspector**: Safe, local Rust CLI for inspecting ELF binaries, headers, and security mitigations without executing them. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/binary-inspector); [source](https://github.com/bisug/BinaryInspector)
- **Paila**: Travel & community platform bridging tourists and local communities in Nepal, built with Next.js and Supabase. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/paila); [source](https://github.com/bisug/Paila); [live site](https://paila-prototype.vercel.app)
- **tgcrypto-c**: Forked pyrogram/tgcrypto because the original is unmaintained and doesn't support newer Python versions. Added AES-NI hardware acceleration (6-14x faster), reusable streaming contexts, type stubs, and wheels for Linux/macOS/Windows. Drop-in replacement for Pyrogram and Kurigram. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/tgcrypto-c); [source](https://github.com/bisug/tgcrypto-c); [live site](https://pypi.org/project/tgcrypto-c/)
- **ninfo**: Built to explore Nim. A Linux system information CLI that captures a whole-system snapshot as JSON in a single call — system, CPU, memory, storage, network, processes, sensors, and battery. No root, no dependencies, single static binary. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/ninfo); [source](https://github.com/bisug/ninfo)
- **heroku-buildpack-bun**: Unofficial Heroku buildpack for Bun: installs official binaries, caches builds, and runs bun install. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/heroku-buildpack-bun); [source](https://github.com/bisug/heroku-buildpack-bun)
- **SnakeGame-CLI**: Cross-platform classic Snake game running entirely in the terminal with zero external GUI dependencies. [Project page](https://bisu.com.np/projects/snake-game-cli); [source](https://github.com/bisug/SnakeGame-CLI)
